package windows

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/smb/internal/wire"
)

func cacheGatePositiveTestObserver() *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver {
	return &cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver{pending: make(map[uint64]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord), emit: func(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {}}
}
func cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t *testing.T, command uint16, mid uint64, flags, status uint32, body []byte) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	packet := make([]byte, wire.HeaderSize+len(body))
	if err := (wire.Header{Command: command, MessageID: mid, Flags: flags, Status: status}).Encode(packet); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	copy(packet[wire.HeaderSize:], body)
	return packet
}
func cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(packet []byte) []byte {
	n := len(packet)
	return append([]byte{0, byte(n >> 16), byte(n >> 8), byte(n)}, packet...)
}
func cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t *testing.T, mid uint64, class byte, id wire.FileID, flags uint32) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	body := make([]byte, 40)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 41)
	body[2], body[3] = 1, class
	copy(body[24:40], id[:])
	return cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, mid, flags, 0, body)
}
func cacheGatePositiveTestCompound(packets ...[]byte) []byte {
	var result []byte
	for i, p := range packets {
		p = append([]byte(nil), p...)
		if i+1 < len(packets) {
			p = append(p, make([]byte, (-len(p))&7)...)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(p[20:24], uint32(len(p)))
		}
		result = append(result, p...)
	}
	return result
}

func TestGatePositiveWireSplitCompoundResponses(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	id := wire.FileID{1, 2, 3}
	request := cacheGatePositiveTestCompound(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 20, 4, id, 0), cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 21, 5, id, 0))
	for _, b := range cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(request) {
		o.observe([]byte{b}, false)
	}
	basic := make([]byte, 40)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(basic[16:24], 123456789)
	standard := make([]byte, 24)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(standard[8:16], 98765)
	response := cacheGatePositiveTestCompound(
		cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 20, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(basic)),
		cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 21, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(standard)),
	)
	for _, b := range cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(response) {
		o.observe([]byte{b}, true)
	}
	o.finish()
	if o.incomplete || len(o.records) != 4 || len(o.pending) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("records=%+v pending=%d incomplete=%v", o.records, len(o.pending), o.incomplete)
	}
	if o.records[2].QueryClass != 4 || o.records[2].MTime != 123456789 || o.records[3].QueryClass != 5 || o.records[3].EOF != 98765 || o.records[3].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(id[:]) {
		t.Fatalf("response association lost: %+v", o.records)
	}
	for _, r := range o.records {
		if r.At.IsZero() {
			t.Fatal("missing observation timestamp")
		}
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireReadDigestExcludesPayload(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	payload := []byte("DO-NOT-LOG-READ-PAYLOAD")
	body := make([]byte, 48)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 49)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(body[4:8], uint32(len(payload)))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(body[8:16], 4096)
	body[16] = 8
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Read, 8, 0, 0, body)), false)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Read, 8, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.ReadResponseBody(payload, 0))), true)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(o.records)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	digest := sha256.Sum256(payload)
	r := o.records[len(o.records)-1]
	if o.incomplete || r.Digest != hex.EncodeToString(digest[:]) || r.Count != uint32(len(payload)) || r.Offset != 4096 {
		t.Fatalf("read evidence: %+v", r)
	}
	if bytes.Contains(encoded, payload) {
		t.Fatalf("file payload leaked: %s", encoded)
	}
	if o.streams[1].frame != nil {
		t.Fatal("completed frame retained")
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireRelatedCreateAndQuery(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	create := make([]byte, 56)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(create, 57)
	id := wire.FileID{9, 7, 6}
	related := wire.FileID{}
	for i := range related {
		related[i] = 0xff
	}
	request := cacheGatePositiveTestCompound(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Create, 0, 0, 0, create), cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 1, 6, related, wire.FlagRelated))
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(request), false)
	internal := make([]byte, 8)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(internal, 444)
	response := cacheGatePositiveTestCompound(
		cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Create, 0, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.CreateResponseBody(wire.CreateResult{FileID: id, FileInformation: wire.FileInformation{EndOfFile: 23, WriteTime: 456}})),
		cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 1, wire.FlagResponse|wire.FlagRelated, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(internal)),
	)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(response), true)
	if o.incomplete || len(o.records) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("records=%+v", o.records)
	}
	if o.records[2].EOF != 23 || o.records[2].MTime != 456 || o.records[3].FileID != hex.EncodeToString(id[:]) || o.records[3].InternalID != 444 {
		t.Fatalf("related CREATE result lost: %+v", o.records)
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireErrorsPendingAndSecrets(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	body := make([]byte, 8)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
	body = append(body, []byte("DO-NOT-LOG-AUTH-TOKEN")...)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.SessionSetup, 4, 0, 0, body)), false)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.SessionSetup, 4, wire.FlagResponse, 0xc0000016, body)), true)
	notify := make([]byte, 32)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(notify, 32)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.ChangeNotify, 5, 0, 0, notify)), false)
	errorBody := make([]byte, 8)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(errorBody, 9)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.ChangeNotify, 5, wire.FlagResponse|wire.FlagAsync, 0x103, errorBody)), true)
	if len(o.pending) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("pending response lost correlation")
	}
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.ChangeNotify, 5, wire.FlagResponse|wire.FlagAsync, 0xc0000120, errorBody)), true)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(o.records)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if o.incomplete || len(o.pending) != 0 || bytes.Contains(encoded, []byte("DO-NOT-LOG-AUTH-TOKEN")) {
		t.Fatalf("status or secret handling: %s", encoded)
	}
	if o.records[2].Command != wire.ChangeNotify {
		t.Fatal("notification command not recorded")
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireMalformedAndBounds(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name string
		run  func(*cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver)
	}{
		{"partial prefix", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) { o.observe([]byte{0, 0}, false); o.finish(); o.finish() }},
		{"partial body", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.observe([]byte{0, 0, 0, 64, 0xfe, 'S', 'M', 'B'}, true)
			o.finish()
		}},
		{"oversized frame", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) { o.observe([]byte{0, 0x10, 0, 1}, false) }},
		{"transformed frame", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame([]byte("\xfdSMB")), true)
		}},
		{"invalid compound offset", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			p := cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 1, 4, wire.FileID{}, 0)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(p[20:24], 64)
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(p), false)
		}},
		{"truncated query result", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 1, 4, wire.FileID{}, 0)), false)
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 1, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(make([]byte, 39)))), true)
		}},
		{"unmatched response", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 1, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(make([]byte, 40)))), true)
		}},
		{"command mismatch", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 1, 4, wire.FileID{}, 0)), false)
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Read, 1, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.ReadResponseBody(nil, 0))), true)
		}},
		{"pending bound", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			for i := 0; i <= cacheGatePositiveMaxPending; i++ {
				o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, uint64(i), 4, wire.FileID{}, 0)), false)
			}
		}},
		{"record bound", func(o *cacheGatePositiveFrameObserver) {
			o.records = make([]cacheGatePositiveWireRecord, cacheGatePositiveMaxRecords)
			o.record(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{})
		}},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
			test.run(o)
			if !o.incomplete {
				t.Fatalf("malformed evidence accepted: %+v", o.records)
			}
			if len(o.pending) > cacheGatePositiveMaxPending || len(o.records) > cacheGatePositiveMaxRecords {
				t.Fatal("bounded storage exceeded")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireBootstrapAndContextBounds(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	bootstrap := make([]byte, 35)
	copy(bootstrap, "\xffSMB")
	bootstrap[4] = 0x72
	dialect := []byte("\x02SMB 2.???\x00")
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(bootstrap[33:35], uint16(len(dialect)))
	bootstrap = append(bootstrap, dialect...)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(bootstrap), false)
	body := make([]byte, 64)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 65)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Negotiate, 0, wire.FlagResponse, 0, body)), true)
	if o.incomplete || len(o.records) != 2 || !o.records[0].Bootstrap {
		t.Fatalf("bootstrap rejected: %+v", o.records)
	}
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		length uint32
		next   uint32
	}{
		{"valid", 32, 0}, {"truncated lease", 31, 0}, {"overflow data", ^uint32(0), 0}, {"invalid next", 32, 8},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			context := make([]byte, 56)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(context, test.next)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[4:6], 16)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[6:8], 4)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[10:12], 24)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(context[12:16], test.length)
			copy(context[16:20], "RqLs")
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(context[40:44], 0)
			r := cacheGatePositiveWireRecord{}
			packet := append(make([]byte, 152), context...)
			valid := cacheGatePositiveContexts(packet, 152, uint32(len(context)), 152, &r)
			if valid != (test.name == "valid") {
				t.Fatalf("context validity=%v", valid)
			}
			if valid && (!r.LeasePresent || r.LeaseState != 0) {
				t.Fatalf("lease state missing: %+v", r)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireConnectionIsolationAndReset(t *testing.T) {
	// This test owns the registry while no native bridge is running.
	cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	defer cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	a := cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
	b := cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
	a.emit = func(cacheGatePositiveWireRecord) {}
	b.emit = a.emit
	a.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 1, 4, wire.FileID{1}, 0)), false)
	b.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 1, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(make([]byte, 40)))), true)
	records, incomplete := cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if !incomplete || len(records) < 2 || !b.incomplete || a.incomplete {
		t.Fatalf("cross-connection association accepted: %+v", records)
	}
	cacheGateResetPositiveWire()
	records, incomplete = cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if incomplete || len(records) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("reset retained evidence")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 17; i++ {
		cacheGateNewPositiveFrameObserver()
	}
	_, incomplete = cacheGatePositiveWireSnapshot()
	if !incomplete {
		t.Fatal("connection bound was not reported")
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireSensitiveCreateContextExcluded(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	secret := []byte("DO-NOT-LOG-CONTEXT-PAYLOAD")
	context := make([]byte, 24+len(secret))
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[4:6], 16)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[6:8], 4)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(context[10:12], 24)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(context[12:16], uint32(len(secret)))
	copy(context[16:20], "Test")
	copy(context[24:], secret)
	create := make([]byte, 56)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(create, 57)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(create[48:52], 120)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(create[52:56], uint32(len(context)))
	create = append(create, context...)
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.Create, 9, 0, 0, create)), false)
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(o.records)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if o.incomplete || strings.Contains(string(encoded), string(secret)) {
		t.Fatalf("context capture invalid: %s", encoded)
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireDelayedResponseJoinsRequestInterval(t *testing.T) {
	o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
	nativeStart := time.Now().UTC()
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 50, 4, wire.FileID{3}, 0)), false)
	nativeEnd := time.Now().UTC()
	o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 50, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(make([]byte, 40)))), true)
	if o.incomplete || len(o.records) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("records=%+v", o.records)
	}
	req, res := o.records[0], o.records[1]
	if req.Response || !res.Response || req.Connection != res.Connection || req.MessageID != res.MessageID || req.Command != res.Command {
		t.Fatal("request response join lost")
	}
	if req.At.Before(nativeStart) || req.At.After(nativeEnd) || res.At.Before(nativeEnd) {
		t.Fatalf("request interval [%v,%v], request=%v response=%v", nativeStart, nativeEnd, req.At, res.At)
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireIncompleteSelectedBufferResults(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []uint32{0x80000005, 0xc0000023} {
		o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
		o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 70, 4, wire.FileID{4}, 0)), false)
		body := make([]byte, 8)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
		o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 70, wire.FlagResponse, status, body)), true)
		if !o.incomplete || o.records[1].Incomplete == "" || o.records[1].Status != status {
			t.Fatalf("partial metadata result accepted: %+v", o.records)
		}
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireNetworkOpenInformation(t *testing.T) {
	// FILE_NETWORK_OPEN_INFORMATION has six 64-bit values followed by attributes.
	// https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-hardware/drivers/ddi/wdm/ns-wdm-_file_network_open_information
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		length int
	}{
		{"truncated", 55}, {"complete", 56}, {"overlong", 57},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
			id := wire.FileID{3, 4}
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 34, 34, id, 0)), false)
			data := make([]byte, test.length)
			const mtime uint64 = 0x0123456789abcdef
			const eof uint64 = 0x0000000123456789
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[8:16], 111)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[16:24], mtime)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[24:32], 222)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[32:40], 333)
			binary.LittleEndian.PutUint64(data[40:48], eof)
			o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 34, wire.FlagResponse, 0, wire.BufferResponseBody(data))), true)
			if len(o.records) != 2 {
				t.Fatalf("records=%+v", o.records)
			}
			r := o.records[1]
			if test.length != 56 {
				if !o.incomplete || r.Incomplete == "" {
					t.Fatalf("invalid network information length accepted: %+v", r)
				}
				return
			}
			if o.incomplete || r.QueryClass != 34 || r.QueryType != 1 || r.FileID != hex.EncodeToString(id[:]) || r.MTime != mtime || r.EOF != eof {
				t.Fatalf("network information decode or correlation lost: %+v", r)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGatePositiveWireIncompleteNetworkOpenBufferResults(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []uint32{0x80000005, 0xc0000023} {
		o := cacheGatePositiveTestObserver()
		o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestQuery(t, 34, 34, wire.FileID{3, 4}, 0)), false)
		body := make([]byte, 8)
		binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(body, 9)
		o.observe(cacheGatePositiveTestFrame(cacheGatePositiveTestPacket(t, wire.QueryInfo, 34, wire.FlagResponse, status, body)), true)
		if !o.incomplete || len(o.records) != 2 || o.records[1].Incomplete == "" || o.records[1].Status != status {
			t.Fatalf("partial network metadata accepted: %+v", o.records)
		}
	}
}
